_README: Blank template. Copy to assets/content.<quarter>.local.json (gitignored) and fill from this quarter's notes. Replace every <placeholder>. Do not commit a populated copy - it will contain names, pay/role changes and candid notes. Angle-bracket text is a prompt to fill, not literal output.

config.title: Operations deep dive
config.subtitle: Workshop summary and 30/60/90 plan
config.workshop_context: <e.g. Earlier in May 2026 - used in the opening sentence>
config.plan_start: <e.g. 25 May 2026 - a Monday reads best; phase dates are computed from this>
config.owner_title: <operations owner title, e.g. Head of Professional Services>
config.org_chart_image: <optional absolute path to org chart PNG, or empty string>
config.output_dir: <absolute path to the folder where the .docx/.pptx should be written>
config.file_stem: Operations Deep Dive - Workshop Summary and 30-60-90
config._comment: deck_template is optional; defaults to the accelerate-slides 2026 template. Override only to use a different .pptx.

wins: <a win worth protecting - what's working and why it matters>

themes.title: <theme title, e.g. Project lifecycle and onboarding>
themes.body: <2-4 plain sentences naming the gap and why it costs us time or margin>

decisions: <a decision settled in the room - stated as settled, not up for debate>

kpis.kpi: Projects over or forecast over budget
kpis.target: Every at-risk project flagged with a recovery plan; none unmanaged
Within 10% either way at sprint close

ceo.label: <CEO first name> (CEO)
ceo.scope: <the calls only the CEO can make: policy, contracts, remuneration, resourcing; holds the owner to the KPIs>

owner.label: <owner first name> (<title>)
owner.scope: <owns the operating system end to end: ratifies roles, runs the scorecard, builds the cadence>

<design proposals, knowledge transfer, estimate accuracy, DevOps discipline>
<probability, budget, variations, change requests, escalations, RAID governance>

phases.intro: Set the foundations. Agree the standards, write the roles, and stand up the systems.

phases.intro: Operationalise the decisions. Get the cadence running and the data flowing.

actions.team_action: <team-safe rephrasing shown in the team version instead>

phases.intro: Measure, prove it works, and lock it into business as usual.

ideas: <an idea that sits alongside the plan rather than inside it>

deck._comment: Fill only when building the readout deck. Keep each bullet to roughly one line; the deck is always team-safe (no confidential content).
